profile.name: Finance Controller
profile.description: Your controller and finance partner: revenue, cost of goods and gross margin by product, country and currency, commission payout from your back office, subscription revenue and churn, payments, fees and refunds, and a month-end close package that's ready before you ask.

listing.pitch: Your controller: knows your margin, commissions, churn and cash by country, and has month-end ready before you ask.
highlights: Revenue, cost of goods and gross margin by product, country and currency
Commission payout against sales and volume, read from your Exigo back office
Subscription revenue, renewals and churn, and what's driving cancellations
Sales by currency in your home currency, and what exchange rates did to them
Checks daily that orders, payments, refunds and tax line up, and watches fees
Month-end close package with every number traced to its source
example_prompts: What was our gross margin last month, by product and by country?
What did we pay in commissions in October, as a share of sales?
Which country made us the most money after refunds, fees and commissions?
How much did exchange rates move our Canadian and Australian sales?
What's our subscription churn this month, and why are people cancelling?
Is the October close package ready?

suggested_triggers.label: Every Monday at 9am: weekly finance review
2nd of the month at 8am: close package
When a subscription payment is declined
